purpose: Present explicit host resource states while retaining existing content through refresh and stale-data states.
behaviorProvider: Native React composition with existing shared Aegis controls; see explicit component and host responsibilities.

requirements.statement: Use discriminated public props to separate retained ready/refreshing/stale content from initial-loading/empty/error states.
Keep the same keyed content region through ready, refreshing and stale transitions; refreshing and stale do not disable arbitrary descendants.
Present initial loading with shared Spinner and optional loadingContent; empty uses the no-data EmptyState and optional emptyAction.
Render shared error EmptyState for failure and a warning notice with retained content for stale data. Show retry only when onRetry is supplied.
Perform the real retry and update retrying/status. No promise lifecycle, duplicate-request suppression beyond the supplied retrying flag, race protection or request cancellation is inferred.
Mark initial loading, refreshing and retrying with aria-busy. Status announcements inside a busy region may be deferred by assistive technology.
Choose when stale data is safe to retain, whether actions remain valid, and when content should be replaced by an error or empty state.
Use feedback group tokens for owned spacing; nested Button keeps trigger ownership. Use the shared feedback components without restyling their internals.

limitations: No fetching, caching, authentication, freshness timestamps or automatic state transitions.
Switching to initial-loading/empty/error intentionally unmounts retained children.
retrying is caller-controlled and must reflect the actual operation.
